sources.title: Introducing Scribe v2 - elevenlabs.io
sources.snippet: Scribe v2 is now used in ElevenLabs Studio for more accurate subtitles, captions and transcriptions, supporting teams that manage large libraries of audio and video across marketing, media, research, training, and compliance use cases.
